Welcome to the Campus One Digital Academy System!
​Here is a quick guide on how to use the main features of this application:
​1. Student Management Click the "Student" button on the Main Menu to open the Student Registration form. Here, you can add new student records, update existing details, or delete records from the database.
​2. Teacher Management Click the "Teacher" button on the Main Menu to open the Teacher Registration form. This section allows you to manage all teacher-related information and records easily.
​3. File Menu Use the "File" menu at the top left corner to Log Out of your current session safely and return to the Login screen.
​4. Exit System Click the "Exit" button (or use the File menu) to close the application. The system will ask for your confirmation before completely shutting down to prevent accidental closures.
​For further technical support or system errors, please contact the System Administrator.
